result.instructions: Tools for Svix, hosted by usefulapi.io. Read-only tools never change data; ask the user before a tool that creates, changes or deletes Svix data. Free plan: 100 tool calls per month. Run svix_usage_status to see the calls used this month. If the user asks for something none of these tools can do, tell the user and, with their OK, run svix_request_feature to record the request. Pro (unlimited calls, $9/month or $90/year): when the user wants more calls or reaches the limit, run svix_upgrade; it returns a Stripe Checkout link for the user to open. svix_cancel_subscription cancels Pro at the end of the paid period.

tools.name: svix_list_applications
tools.title: List applications
tools.description: List the applications (your tenants/customers) in the Svix environment. Svix REST: GET /api/v1/app.

iterator.description: Cursor from the previous page's `iterator` field. Omit for the first page.

exclude_apps_with_no_endpoints.description: Skip applications that have no endpoints configured.

tools.name: svix_get_application
tools.title: Get one application
tools.description: Fetch a single application by its Svix id or your own uid. Svix REST: GET /api/v1/app/{app_id}.

app_id.description: The application's Svix id (app_...) or your uid.

tools.name: svix_list_endpoints
tools.title: List endpoints
tools.description: List the webhook endpoints registered for one application. Svix REST: GET /api/v1/app/{app_id}/endpoint.

app_id.description: The application's Svix id or uid.

iterator.description: Cursor from the previous page's `iterator` field. Omit for the first page.

tools.name: svix_get_endpoint
tools.title: Get one endpoint
tools.description: Fetch a single webhook endpoint, including its URL, subscribed event types and channels. Svix REST: GET /api/v1/app/{app_id}/endpoint/{endpoint_id}.

app_id.description: The application's Svix id or uid.

endpoint_id.description: The endpoint's Svix id (ep_...) or uid.

tools.name: svix_get_endpoint_stats
tools.title: Get endpoint delivery stats
tools.description: Read delivery statistics for one endpoint — counts of success, pending, sending and fail. The fastest way to see whether an endpoint is healthy. Svix REST: GET /api/v1/app/{app_id}/endpoint/{endpoint_id}/stats.

app_id.description: The application's Svix id or uid.

endpoint_id.description: The endpoint's Svix id or uid.

since.description: ISO-8601 start of the window, e.g. 2026-08-01T00:00:00Z.

tools.name: svix_list_messages
tools.title: List messages
tools.description: List the webhook messages sent for one application, newest first. Filter by event type, channel, tag or time window. Svix REST: GET /api/v1/app/{app_id}/msg.

app_id.description: The application's Svix id or uid.

iterator.description: Cursor from the previous page's `iterator` field. Omit for the first page.

event_types.description: Only messages of these event types, e.g. ["invoice.paid"].

before.description: ISO-8601 upper bound on message time.

after.description: ISO-8601 lower bound on message time.

with_content.description: Include each message's payload. Defaults to true.

tools.name: svix_get_message
tools.title: Get one message
tools.description: Fetch a single message, including its event type and payload. Svix REST: GET /api/v1/app/{app_id}/msg/{msg_id}.

app_id.description: The application's Svix id or uid.

msg_id.description: The message's Svix id (msg_...) or your eventId.

with_content.description: Include the payload. Defaults to true.

tools.name: svix_list_attempts_by_message
tools.title: List delivery attempts for a message
tools.description: List every delivery attempt Svix made for one message, across endpoints — status, response code and body. This is the tool for answering 'why did this webhook not arrive?'. Svix REST: GET /api/v1/app/{app_id}/attempt/msg/{msg_id}.

app_id.description: The application's Svix id or uid.

iterator.description: Cursor from the previous page's `iterator` field. Omit for the first page.

status.description: Filter by attempt status: 0 success, 1 pending, 2 fail, 3 sending.

annotations.title: List delivery attempts for a message

tools.name: svix_list_attempts_by_endpoint
tools.title: List delivery attempts for an endpoint
tools.description: List delivery attempts against one endpoint, newest first. Filter by status to find the failures. Svix REST: GET /api/v1/app/{app_id}/attempt/endpoint/{endpoint_id}.

app_id.description: The application's Svix id or uid.

endpoint_id.description: The endpoint's Svix id or uid.

iterator.description: Cursor from the previous page's `iterator` field. Omit for the first page.

status.description: Filter by attempt status: 0 success, 1 pending, 2 fail, 3 sending.

annotations.title: List delivery attempts for an endpoint

tools.name: svix_list_endpoint_messages
tools.title: List messages for an endpoint
tools.description: List the messages destined for one endpoint, with each message's delivery status. Svix REST: GET /api/v1/app/{app_id}/endpoint/{endpoint_id}/msg.

app_id.description: The application's Svix id or uid.

endpoint_id.description: The endpoint's Svix id or uid.

iterator.description: Cursor from the previous page's `iterator` field. Omit for the first page.

tools.name: svix_list_event_types
tools.title: List event types
tools.description: List the event types defined in the environment — the catalogue endpoints can subscribe to. Svix REST: GET /api/v1/event-type.

iterator.description: Cursor from the previous page's `iterator` field. Omit for the first page.

with_content.description: Include each event type's JSON schema.

tools.name: svix_get_event_type
tools.title: Get one event type
tools.description: Fetch a single event type by name, including its description and JSON schema. Svix REST: GET /api/v1/event-type/{event_type_name}.

event_type_name.description: The event type name, e.g. invoice.paid.

tools.name: svix_list_background_tasks
tools.title: List background tasks
tools.description: List Svix background tasks (bulk replays, expunges, imports) with their status. Use it to follow up a recover or replay. Svix REST: GET /api/v1/background-task.

iterator.description: Cursor from the previous page's `iterator` field. Omit for the first page.

task.description: Filter by task kind, e.g. endpoint.recover.

tools.name: svix_health
tools.title: Check API health
tools.description: Check that the Svix API is reachable and the API key works. Returns 200 with an empty body when healthy. Svix REST: GET /api/v1/health.

tools.name: svix_create_application
tools.title: Create an application
tools.description: Create a new application (one tenant/customer of yours) in the Svix environment. Svix REST: POST /api/v1/app.

uid.description: Your own stable id for this application, unique per environment.

rate_limit.description: Optional throttle rate, messages per second.

tools.name: svix_create_endpoint
tools.title: Create an endpoint
tools.description: Register a webhook endpoint URL for one application, optionally scoped to specific event types and channels. Svix REST: POST /api/v1/app/{app_id}/endpoint.

app_id.description: The application's Svix id or uid.

url.description: The HTTPS URL Svix should deliver webhooks to.

uid.description: Your own stable id for this endpoint.

event_types.description: Only deliver these event types. Omit to receive all of them.

channels.description: Only deliver messages on these channels.

disabled.description: Create the endpoint in a disabled state.

tools.name: svix_send_message
tools.title: Send a message
tools.description: Send a webhook message to every endpoint of an application subscribed to the event type. This delivers real traffic to your customers' URLs. Svix REST: POST /api/v1/app/{app_id}/msg.

app_id.description: The application's Svix id or uid.

event_type.description: The event type name, e.g. invoice.paid. Must already exist.

payload.description: The JSON body delivered to the endpoints.

event_id.description: Your own idempotency id for this message.

channels.description: Restrict delivery to endpoints on these channels.

tools.name: svix_resend_message
tools.title: Resend a message to one endpoint
tools.description: Queue one message for redelivery to one endpoint. The usual fix after a customer's endpoint was down. Svix REST: POST /api/v1/app/{app_id}/msg/{msg_id}/endpoint/{endpoint_id}/resend.

app_id.description: The application's Svix id or uid.

annotations.title: Resend a message to one endpoint

tools.name: svix_recover_endpoint
tools.title: Recover an endpoint's failed messages
tools.description: Replay every failed message for one endpoint since a timestamp. Runs as a background task — follow it with svix_list_background_tasks. Svix REST: POST /api/v1/app/{app_id}/endpoint/{endpoint_id}/recover.

app_id.description: The application's Svix id or uid.

since.description: ISO-8601 start of the replay window, e.g. 2026-08-01T00:00:00Z.

until.description: ISO-8601 end of the replay window. Defaults to now.
